name: Push Day — Beginner
blurb: Machines and dumbbells for the pressing muscles. Learn the patterns before you load them.

name: Push Day — Intermediate
blurb: Chest, shoulders and triceps — the pressing half of an upper/lower split.

name: Push Day — Advanced
blurb: Incline barbell heavy, then dips, laterals and two ways to finish the triceps.

name: Push Day at Home — Beginner
blurb: Chest, shoulders and triceps with a pair of dumbbells and a bit of floor.

name: Push Day at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Dumbbells and a band. Two chest angles, an overhead press, and the side delts after.

name: Push Day at Home — Advanced
blurb: Dips and deficit push-ups at home, with the dumbbells heavy and the sets long.

name: Chest & Triceps — Beginner
blurb: Three chest angles and two triceps movements, guided by machines throughout.

name: Chest & Triceps — Intermediate
blurb: Bench, incline and close grip, then the triceps on their own terms.

name: Chest & Triceps — Advanced
blurb: Heavy off the flat bench, a decline angle, and a long block of triceps work.

name: Chest & Triceps at Home — Beginner
blurb: Dumbbells and a band. Three angles on the chest, two on the triceps, then a mile.

name: Chest & Triceps at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Flat press and dips lead, then a fly and two ways of loading the elbow.

name: Chest & Triceps at Home — Advanced
blurb: Five sets on the press, three chest angles, and triceps until the lockout goes.

name: Pull Day — Beginner
blurb: Machines and an assisted bar — the pulling day learned before it is loaded.

name: Pull Day — Intermediate
blurb: Back and biceps. Starts heavy off the floor, finishes with the arms.

name: Pull Day — Advanced
blurb: Deficit pulls, chest-to-bar work and strict rows, for a back with years behind it.

name: Pull Day at Home — Beginner
blurb: A band and a pair of dumbbells — a whole pulling session with no bar in the room.

name: Pull Day at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Pull-ups lead, dumbbells and straps fill it out, and no cable stack is required.

name: Pull Day at Home — Advanced
blurb: Hard bodyweight pulling and heavy single-arm rows, finished at the traps and elbows.

name: Back & Biceps — Beginner
blurb: Lats, mid-back and both curl grips, on equipment that holds your position for you.

name: Back & Biceps — Intermediate
blurb: Rack pulls into chin-ups, then rows, then two curls that finish the arms off.

name: Back & Biceps — Advanced
blurb: Snatch-grip pulls, wide pull-ups and Meadows rows — the long version of a back day.

name: Back & Biceps at Home — Beginner
blurb: Band-assisted pulling, a back extension and two curl grips, all from the floor up.

name: Back & Biceps at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Chin-ups and seal rows, hinged posterior work, and a run to close the session.

name: Back & Biceps at Home — Advanced
blurb: Archer pull-ups, kettlebell rows and spider curls, with only what a home rack holds.

name: Leg Day — Beginner
blurb: Machines and a goblet squat — legs trained before the barbell earns a place in it.

name: Leg Day — Intermediate
blurb: Squat first, then everything that holds the squat up.

name: Leg Day — Advanced
blurb: Pause squats, then a deficit pull — a leg day for a training age measured in years.

name: Leg Day at Home — Beginner
blurb: A pair of dumbbells and a step: the squat and the hinge, learned side by side.

name: Leg Day at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Front-rack bells, single-leg hinges and swings — no rack required, no pattern skipped.

name: Leg Day at Home — Advanced
blurb: Pistols, Nordics and loaded split squats — single-leg work with nowhere to hide.

name: Arm Day — Beginner
blurb: Biceps and triceps on machines and dumbbells, for elbows still learning the movements.

name: Arm Day — Intermediate
blurb: Close-grip press and chin-ups lead; the cables and the curls come after.

name: Arm Day — Advanced
blurb: Eight movements, biceps matched to triceps set for set — volume for arms that have stalled.

name: Arm Day at Home — Beginner
blurb: Bench dips, dumbbells and a band — arms built in a spare room with nothing bolted down.

name: Arm Day at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Chin-ups and close-grip push-ups first, then the dumbbells finish the elbows.

name: Arm Day at Home — Advanced
blurb: Straight-bar dips and commando pull-ups — the hardest arm work a doorway bar allows.

name: Women’s Push Day — Beginner
blurb: Fixed-path pressing for chest and shoulders, with the raises and the arms behind it.

name: Women’s Push Day — Intermediate
blurb: The overhead press leads. Delts from three angles, then the hips to close it out.

name: Women’s Push Day — Advanced
blurb: Heavy incline, a push press, and enough delt volume to change the outline.

name: Women’s Push Day at Home — Beginner
blurb: Dumbbells, a band and a wall. The pressing pattern learned before it is loaded.

name: Women’s Push Day at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Standing press first, then one arm at a time, then everything the shoulder owes.

name: Women’s Push Day at Home — Advanced
blurb: Dips lead, Arnolds follow, and the shoulders keep working after the chest is done.

name: Women’s Chest & Triceps — Beginner
blurb: Two chest angles on machines, then the triceps twice. Nothing that needs a spotter.

name: Women’s Chest & Triceps — Intermediate
blurb: Incline dumbbells into a close grip, then the arms, then the hips before you leave.

name: Women’s Chest & Triceps — Advanced
blurb: Flat bench heavy, incline heavy, dips, and three ways at the back of the arm.

name: Women’s Chest & Triceps at Home — Beginner
blurb: Push-ups scaled to your strength, dumbbells for the chest, a band for the triceps.

name: Women’s Chest & Triceps at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Two dumbbell presses and a fly, the arms after, and a run to finish on.

name: Women’s Chest & Triceps at Home — Advanced
blurb: A heavy dumbbell press, a deficit push-up, and the long head worked three ways.

name: Women’s Pull Day — Beginner
blurb: Lats, upper back and arms on fixed machines — the first pull day, learned in a safe groove.

name: Women’s Pull Day — Intermediate
blurb: Assisted pull-ups and barbell rows, then a hinge and the rear delts that hold your posture up.

name: Women’s Pull Day — Advanced
blurb: Chest-to-bar pull-ups, Pendlay rows and heavy hips. This one assumes years, not months.

name: Women’s Pull Day at Home — Beginner
blurb: Two bands and a mat. Real pulling for the athlete who does not own a pull-up yet.

name: Women’s Pull Day at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Negatives on the bar, heavy single-arm rows, a hinge, and a mile to finish.

name: Women’s Pull Day at Home — Advanced
blurb: Full pull-ups, elevated rows and single-leg hinging — the hardest session on the home shelf.

name: Women’s Back & Biceps — Beginner
blurb: Cables and machines for the back, two curls to finish. A first back day, guided throughout.

name: Women’s Back & Biceps — Intermediate
blurb: A heavy row leads, a pull-through builds the hips, and the arms get their own two lifts.

name: Women’s Back & Biceps — Advanced
blurb: Deadlift, wide pull-ups and strict seal rows, then curls. A back day with a training age.

name: Women’s Back & Biceps at Home — Beginner
blurb: Bands, dumbbells and a doorway — back, rear delts and glutes without leaving the room.

name: Women’s Back & Biceps at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Chin-ups lead, a kettlebell hinge follows, the arms finish. No barbell anywhere in it.

name: Women’s Back & Biceps at Home — Advanced
blurb: Bodyweight pull-ups, gorilla rows and single-leg hinging. Advanced work without a rack.

name: Women’s Leg Day — Beginner
blurb: Leg press, hip thrust and curls — the machine route into a complete lower body.

name: Women’s Leg Day — Intermediate
blurb: Barbell squat and Romanian deadlift lead; the split squat and abductors clean up behind them.

name: Women’s Leg Day — Advanced
blurb: Front squats at four reps, then stiff-leg pulls, loaded split squats and a hamstring raise.

name: Women’s Leg Day at Home — Beginner
blurb: Goblet squats and hinges off one pair of dumbbells — the whole leg without a rack.

name: Women’s Leg Day at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Single-leg work throughout: goblet squat, one-leg hinge, Bulgarian split squat, calves.

name: Women’s Leg Day at Home — Advanced
blurb: Double kettlebell front squats and Nordic curls — a hard lower body with no machine in sight.

name: Women’s Glute Day — Beginner
blurb: Machine hip thrust, a cable hinge and dedicated abduction work — the whole glute, nothing to balance.

name: Women’s Glute Day — Intermediate
blurb: Barbell hip thrust first, then the single-leg work the glute medius cannot hide from.

name: Women’s Glute Day — Advanced
blurb: Heavy hip thrusts, good mornings and barbell split squats, finished with high-rep abduction.

name: Women’s Glute Day at Home — Beginner
blurb: A band, dumbbells and a step: bridge, hinge and abduct, then a mile on the road.

name: Women’s Glute Day at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Loaded bridges, a stiff-leg hinge and split squats — no barbell, no shortage of work.

name: Women’s Glute Day at Home — Advanced
blurb: Dumbbell hip thrusts and single-leg hinges, then swings and high-rep pumps to finish.

name: Women’s Arm Day — Beginner
blurb: Biceps and triceps on the machines and cables, closing with lateral raises and a ride.

name: Women’s Arm Day — Intermediate
blurb: Close-grip bench and barbell curls first, then the ropes, the cuffs and a face pull.

name: Women’s Arm Day — Advanced
blurb: Dips and chin-ups before any cable touches your hands, then skull crushers and preacher curls.

name: Women’s Arm Day at Home — Beginner
blurb: Push-ups, bench dips and light dumbbells — arms learned in an afternoon at home.

name: Women’s Arm Day at Home — Intermediate
blurb: Close-grip push-ups lead, then dumbbells and straps through both heads of the arm.

name: Women’s Arm Day at Home — Advanced
blurb: Chin-ups and diamond push-ups open it; bands and dumbbells take whatever is left.

name: Upper Body
blurb: Push and pull in the same session — the upper half of an upper/lower week.

name: Lower Body
blurb: Quads, hamstrings, glutes and calves — the other half of the week.

name: Full Body Express
blurb: Four compound lifts, whole body. For the day you have forty minutes.
